text:
oncall-bot: [ALERT] High GPU queue growth detected in prod-gpu Pool (us-west-2). autoscaler events show frequent scale attempts.

devon: paging oncall — seeing queue length spike for embeddings and chat-generation. 429s and long tails for customer requests.

sara: I'm on it, looking at metrics. which pool? names?

devon: pool-prod-gpu-usw2. autoscaler logs: 'reached nodeGroup max: 50' a few minutes ago and still queue growing.

maria: oh no — that nodeGroup max is the one we set last quarter. customers could be throttled now.

liam: adding logs snippet:
```
I0328 15:02:12 autoscaler.go:220] Attempting scale up: desired=48 current=48
I0328 15:02:42 autoscaler.go:233] Failed to scale: nodeGroup foo-pool hit max nodes (50)
I0328 15:03:01 autoscaler.go:233] Queue backlog=312 requests, avg wait=3.6s
```

sara: thanks. oncall handoff in ~10m — @maria can you take if I'm pulled into customer comms?

maria: I can take. first quick mitigation: can we fallback embeddings requests to smaller quantized model in hosted pool? routing rule exists but needs manual enable.

jay: I can enable routed fallback for embeddings route and increase throttling for low-priority batch jobs. Doing now.

jay: enabled fallback route -> embeddings now routed to hosted-quant model for non-enterprise keys. expect reduced GPU pressure. :white_check_mark:

devon: starting to see decrease in new queue for chat-gen but embeddings still high. some long-running user jobs holding GPU.

liam: listing pods by GPU usage:
```
$ kubectl top pods -n prod | grep gpu
rb-job-zz  4.0  1024Mi
rb-longjob-12  8.0  6Gi  # probable culprit
```

sara: can we preempt or cordon the long jobs? what's impact on customers queued vs active?

maria: we've identified 3 heavy batch jobs from internal analytics — infra ok to evict if needed. @infra-bot can you confirm evictable annotation present?

infra-bot: evictable=true on jobs with label team=analytics. Eviction will free ~18 GPUs across pool.

devon: eviction ok. please kill analytics longjobs after notifying their owners. I'll post owner pings.

jay: evict initiated. pods terminating.

liam: immediate drop in GPU utilization. but autoscaler still reports at max nodes; new nodes won't spin up because limit hit.

sara: we need manual cap raise on node group to allow scale to catch up. @maria can you request cap increase with cloud infra? Use escalations channel.

maria: opened escalation ticket to cloud provider and internal infra: ticket #INC-8421. Requesting increase from 50 -> 70 nodes for foo-pool. ETA for acceptance ~8-15m. CC @infra.

infra-bot: Cloud provider response: request received, currently queued. Provisioning SLA estimated 12 minutes.

devon: meanwhile enabling emergency throttle: reduce max tokens per request for chat endpoints from 4096 -> 1024 to lower per-token load.

jay: throttle applied. we're also temporarily reducing concurrency for free-tier keys.

sara: customer impact summary for comms: some embeddings requests experienced 429s for ~12m window, chat latency increased to 2-6s for most users, a small set of enterprise customers saw degraded throughput but no data loss. documenting now.

maria: cloud approved cap raise. manual node group max updated to 70 via console at 15:25:40 UTC.

liam: autoscaler now able to add nodes. logs:
```
I0328 15:27:02 autoscaler.go:310] Scaled up: new nodes=62 (added 12)
I0328 15:27:42 autoscaler.go:310] Scaled up: new nodes=68 (added 6)
I0328 15:28:10 autoscaler.go:310] Scale complete: current=68 desired=68
```

devon: queue drained, 429s dropped to baseline, latency returning to SLOs. removing emergency throttles in 5m, will keep fallback routing for embeddings for 30m.

sara: handoff: @maria you'll continue watching for 30m and then update incident channel. I'll prepare customer post-incident note template.

maria: ack. monitoring dashboards show stabilizing metrics. will post final impact summary and next steps (autoscale policy tweak, alert thresholds, runbook update).

jay: runbook note: add step to check nodeGroup max vs projected peak in daily capacity report; add automatic paging to infra when scale attempts > 3 and blocked by max.

oncall-bot: [INCIDENT] incident resolved -> status=mitigated. follow-up: create postmortem and schedule oncall review.

sara: creating postmortem draft now, linking logs, ticket #INC-8421, and remediation actions (increase default max for peak windows, add rate-limiter improvements, eviction safeguards).

maria: closing thread for now, will post final summary in ~1h.
